title: Piero and Raffaello
text: Piero de' Medici and Raffaello de' Medici: Brothers, sons of the late Lorenzo. Piero is the elder and the heir.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Piero and Clarice
text: Piero de' Medici and Clarice Orsini: Cousins of the Medici house.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Raffaello and Clarice
text: Raffaello de' Medici and Clarice Orsini: Cousins of the Medici house.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Francesco and Giorgia
text: Francesco Pazzi and Giorgia Pazzi: Brother and sister. Francesco heads the Pazzi house.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Lupo and Francesco
text: Lupo and Francesco Pazzi: Lupo is the Pazzi bodyguard, and Francesco is the man he keeps alive.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: LeNoir and Emile
text: Captain Armand LeNoir and Emile de Valois: LeNoir is captain of the Prince's guard.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Jeanne and Emile
text: Jeanne d'Orléans and Emile de Valois: France's ambassador, who is arranging the Prince's marriage.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Emile and Clarice
text: Emile de Valois and Clarice Orsini: The Prince is choosing a Florentine bride, and Clarice is one of the two he is choosing between.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Emile and Giorgia
text: Emile de Valois and Giorgia Pazzi: The Prince is choosing a Florentine bride, and Giorgia is one of the two he is choosing between.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Clarice and Giorgia
text: Clarice Orsini and Giorgia Pazzi: Rivals for the Prince's hand. Clarice once mocked Giorgia at a banquet as "the Pazzi girl with nothing left".
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Piero and Francesco
text: Piero de' Medici and Francesco Pazzi: Heads of the two rival houses. In 1478 a Pazzi plot killed Piero's uncle, and a Pazzi uncle hanged for it.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Tommaso and Piero
text: Fra Tommaso and Piero de' Medici: Fra Tommaso preaches against the Medici and everything they stand for.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Tommaso and Beatrice
text: Fra Tommaso and Sister Beatrice: Fra Tommaso leads the Dominican order Sister Beatrice serves.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)

title: Tommaso and Isabella
text: Fra Tommaso and Contessa Isabella: Fra Tommaso leads the Dominican order the widowed Contessa joined.
source: Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (Lore v0.6)
